component.name: Bootcraft
component.summary: Set up drivers, codecs and apps after installing Linux

description.p: Post-install setup for Fedora, Arch Linux, Ubuntu, Linux Mint and Debian: the right NVIDIA driver for your card, media codecs, Flatpak with Flathub, fonts and everyday tools, plus curated creative, development and gaming apps from Flathub or your distribution.
Bootcraft shows the full plan before it changes anything, skips what is already in place, and can export the plan as a script.
